definitions.short: a body , whether alive or dead
definitions.full: H1472. gviyah גְּוִיָּה noun feminine body, corpse — absolute ׳ג Nahum 3:3 ; construct גְּוִיַּת Judg 14:8 2 t.; suffix גְּוִיָּתוֺ 1Sam 31:10 ; Dan 10:6 , גְּוִיָּתֵנוּ Gen 47:18 , גְּוִיָּתָם Nahum 3:3 ; plural absolute גְּוִיּוֺת Psa 110:6 ; suffix גְּוִיֹּתֵנוּ Neh 9:37 , גְּוִיֹּתֵיהֶם Ezek 1:23 , גְּוִיֹּתֵיהֶ֑נָֿה 1:11 ; — 1 living human body Gen 47:18 (singular, of many persons), compare plural Neh 9:37 ; of man in Daniel's vision Dan 10:6 (body apart from extremities); also of the living creatures in Ezekiel's vision Ezek 1:11 , 28 . 2 dead body, corpse, carcass: a. of man 1Sam 31:10 (so originally in || 1Chr 10:10 see We Sm compare Dr) 10:12 ; 10:12 (singular of several persons), Psa 110:6 ; collective Nahum 3:3 (twice in verse); b. of lion Judg 14:8-9 ,.
